Name: Smart Cursor (Like Terraria's Smart Cursor)
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
License:
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/DecidedlyHuman/StardewValleyMods[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
Have you played Terraria? Do you wish Stardew had something similar to its smart cursor feature for harvesting resources? Well, now it does!

Just hold down the keybind, and the tool you have equipped (currently pickaxe, axe, and hoe) will target the nearest resource it can gather, up to a maximum range. The range increases the higher your tool's upgrade level.

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b]

See the [url=https://github.com/AlanDavison/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/SmartCursor/release-notes.md]release notes here[/url].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1772986524.png[/img]
